instrument: Bitcoin catalog asset retained; Binance spot BTCUSDT is explicit quote/venue hypothesis. Original11fields do NOT say BTC-USD; do not add USD claim.
input_period: 2022-12-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; do not change input
evaluation: 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; full24calendar months including initial cash/readiness period. Prior exposed availability-selected window, NOT OOS.
monthly_reporting: Month return=end equity/previous month end equity-1; first denominator100000. Continuous account and indicators, no monthly resetting or selective omission of cash/zero-trade months.

capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

execution.at_open: Execute the single earliest-due pending intent when due_index<=current_index and actual position permits; stale intent is logged and discarded, no same-open exit then reentry. Actual timestamp override only as declared for M1180.
at_close_sequence: Update completed-bar indicators and holding counter, compute raw entry/raw exit independent of current position
If M1180 long and completed_count>=20, latch time_exit until the position is closed; it cannot be cancelled by entry filters
A raw opposite signal cancels a pending opposite intent before considering a new one, irrespective of current holdings; for M1180 a latched timeexit is exempt
Schedule new buy only when flat and raw_entry; schedule new sell only when long and raw_exit or time_exit. If both raw directions occur, sell/cancel-buy priority; do not buy
Same-side repeated intent retains its original earliest due index, never postpone due to repeated signals
No signal at equality unless explicitly inclusive; no warmup-generated intent; no fill at or beyond evaluation end
execution.raw_M1258: entry=previous-ready RSI<=50 and current>50; exit=previous-ready RSI>=50 and current<50; computed independently of holdings so a raw opposite cross cancels a pending order even when no new order is eligible
execution.lag2_example: A pending buy at t+2 is cancelled by opposite raw signal at close t+1. An uncancelled same-side signal does not move due from t+2. A 20-bar exit scheduled at e+19 closes at e+21 for lag2; no perpetual defer.

valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.

allocation.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
allocation.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

benchmark.exit: none; mark each source timeframe close to same evaluation end
benchmark.reason_new_control: Existing previously run controls use95%allocation or different fees/window and are not silently reused as matching controls
benchmark.sample_basis: 4h forM1180;daily forM1258, including same-window daily-sampled return metrics; repeated QA/recovery adds0controls

precision: Proposed Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from original decimal CSV strings for indicators and account; recursive update prev+alpha*(x-prev), preserve exact constant input; independent implementation must match seeds/ready mask. Conversion to float only output metrics, no price rounding/tick assumptions.
QA_gate: Recheck exact inputhash/grid/uniqueness/close_time/finite positiveOHLC/nonnegativevolume/trades/OHLC bounds; reject any failure, no imputation/drop/forwardfill. Existing QA accepted input may have low-activity bars; do not silently add volume filter. Halt metadata retained;4h OHLC does not prove continuous executable liquidity.
stop_or_roi: No intrabar stop/ROI added when absent from catalog; gap risk borne by nextopen proxy.
timeframe: 1d hypothesis supported by catalog title naming5day RSI; rule body says5period. Original webpage/runtime remains unverified, quote/venue chosen explicitly as Binance spot BTCUSDT.
RSI5: Close deltas at indices1..5; seed mean gain/loss at index5. Wilder alpha1/5 thereafter, prev+(x-prev)/5. Both means0 -> RSI50; loss0 gain>0 ->100; gain0 loss>0 ->0; otherwise100-100/(1+gain/loss). Five-period Wilder and flat50 are research conventions, not verified author settings.
entry: Flat and previous ready RSI<=50 and current RSI>50; equality is neutral, crossing requires strict current>50.
exit: Long and previous ready RSI>=50 and current RSI<50. At exactly50 retain current holdings. Opposite crossover cancels pending opposite intent; no persistent above50 repeated entries.
capital_provenance: Catalog explicitly assumes every trade full capital;100% fee-inclusive cash required, not95%. Fees/slippage reduce purchased quantity without creating reserve.
cold_start: 31dailybars before eval;RSIready byindex5. Start evalcash, no warmup intent fills firstopen;firstevaluationclose may signal using priorreadyRSI and fill secondopen. No arbitrary200daywarmup.
known_halt: No daily midnight-open override: the known intraday2023-03-24 pause does not coincide with daily execution opens. No general all-history tradability claim.
